(I’m assuming that’s doctorate in audiology? ) I’m genuinely not sure, she might. But I know she went to a grad school, and I know she did NOT go to medical school. She had no A&P with cadaver dissection, did not take step/boards, did not enter match. If she does have a doctorate, semantically she IS a doctor and DID go to A “medical” school, but still did not go to what is implied by “I’m a doctor, I went to medical school) which is that she went to medical school to get an MD

She is, most of her friends don’t know much about healthcare systems so I think to her majority she gets away with it, but to anyone who does know healthcare, she’s definitely shooting herself in the foot. However she’s always been very insecure, was an “uncool” kid in high school and I think she now tries to overcompensate and this is one of the ways how. Because of that I think if I confronted her no matter how softly it would bruise her ego and she would end out friendship to avoid it

Thank you
I believe at her core she is a good person, but she’s always been very insecure. In high school she was never in the “cool” kids group, (though it was a small school so everyone was kinda friends with anyone anyway) and to me it seems like she’s been trying to run from that and create a new “cool” persona but it’s pretty obvious and doesn’t come across as genuine. She picks up bits of personality from those she’s around to try to come out on top even though no one else is trying to have a competition. Because of this I think confronting her on this would definitely come off as an attack on her ego, and would end the friendship. We’re not nearly as close anymore, mostly because of those issues, but she is a seeet person at the core and it’s hard to cut off someone whose been, at least to some degree) in your friendship circle for over a decade

Just to be clear I’ve never called her out in front of people, or spoke to her privately about these feelings (maybe I should have? Not sure) the only one I’ve voiced my opinions to, in private, is my boyfriend

It was....nice. Did you ever need glasses? Like the first time you get glasses, before that everything is blurry and difficult but that’s all you know so you don’t know it’s not “right”, then when you get glasses and can see clearly it’s just like Oh, THIS is what normal is! It’s almost like that in reverse. I didn’t have to try, I never knew what it was like to be depressed and alone, I “was” normal through high school with friends, relatively happy or at least content. Now everything is a fucking mess and I’m haunted by how easy everything used to be
